content.text: This is a clear security incident — unexpected sign-in alerts from an unfamiliar country plus an unrequested MFA prompt suggests possible account compromise. This must be escalated to the Security Team, not troubleshot via KB articles.

input.reasoning_summary: Unrecognized sign-in alerts from a foreign country plus an unsolicited MFA prompt indicate possible account compromise, requiring urgent security review.

summary.reported: Requester received three sign-in alerts from an unfamiliar country and one MFA push notification they did not initiate.
summary.checked: Reviewed the ticket details; no prior comments or history on this ticket. This pattern matches a potential account compromise / credential attack scenario rather than a routine access or password issue.
summary.ruled_out: Not a simple password reset request or benign notification; not something covered by general troubleshooting KB articles.
summary.why_escalating: Unrecognized sign-in attempts combined with an unsolicited MFA prompt are strong indicators of a possible account compromise attempt. This requires immediate security team investigation (e.g., checking sign-in logs, forcing password reset, reviewing MFA device registrations) rather than standard help desk troubleshooting.
